run_atari_game_loader: run the Loader class to initialize an Atari game environment with configurable frame skip and ROM file
run_atari_game_cli: run the Atari game CLI with command line args like --num_games 64 --batchsize 16 --actor_only
create_loader_with_args: create a Loader instance that defines Atari game options including frame skip, hist length, and ROM path
register_actor_callback: register an actor callback function that returns random actions for the Atari game batch
register_train_callback: register a train callback function to process training batches from the Atari game environment
